# Command-line reference

Generated from the argument parsers of both programs. Calculation files are described in
[Input files and terminal commands](../interfaces.md#input-files-and-terminal-commands). Both
programs return exit status 0 on success and 2 when a calculation fails.

## `qdjj-solver`

QP and DMRG solvers for superconducting quantum impurities. Module: `qdjj_solver.cli`.

| Argument | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version` | no value |  | Print the version and exit |

### `qdjj-solver solve`

Solve a finite Hamiltonian.

| Argument | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `configuration` | path | required | JSON calculation file: model, bath, sector, cutoff, backend and solver options |
| `--backend` | `qp`, `dmrg` |  | Solver backend; overrides the configuration's backend, which defaults to qp |
| `--output` | path | required | Path of the output JSON result file |
| `--save-states` | no value |  | Also save the states (QP eigenvectors or DMRG matrix-product states) in a companion file next to the result |
| `--resume` | path |  | DMRG result JSON whose saved MPS checkpoint provides the initial states |

## `qpsolver`

Variational QP expansions for superconducting impurities. Module: `qdjj_solver.qp_solver.cli`.

| Argument | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version` | no value |  | Print the version and exit |

### `qpsolver solve`

Solve a Hamiltonian.

| Argument | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `configuration` | path | required | JSON calculation file in the legacy QP format |
| `--output` | path | required | Path of the output JSON result file |
| `--save-vectors` | no value |  | Also save the eigenvectors in a companion file next to the result |

### `qpsolver dimension`

Report the Hilbert-space dimension of the requested sector.

| Argument | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `configuration` | path | required | JSON calculation file in the legacy QP format |

### `qpsolver fit`

Fit a particle-hole-symmetric BCS surrogate.

| Argument | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--levels` | int | required | Number of signed spinful levels in the surrogate reservoir |
| `--delta` | float | `1.0` | Superconducting gap |
| `--bandwidth` | float | `100.0` | Normal-state half-bandwidth |
| `--frequency-cutoff` | float | `100.0` | Largest imaginary frequency of the logarithmic fitting mesh |
| `--starts` | int | `4` | Number of optimization attempts with different initial guesses |
| `--output` | path | required | Path of the output JSON bath file |

`qpsolver` is the legacy QP-only program; `qdjj-solver` is the unified interface.
